authoritativeWrites.rationale: Discovery creates PENDING work items only when S4 is not killed
Claim acquires lease; forbidden while killed
Heartbeat extends lease; forbidden while killed
Takeover reclaims expired lease; forbidden while killed
Pins evidence snapshot hash on work item; forbidden while killed
Completes work and persists S2 in same tx; forbidden while killed
Only permitted authoritative mutation while killed: release lease to FAILED_RETRYABLE without persisting results
Skip ineligible; forbidden while killed (replay uses T08)
Holder-initiated supersession on boundary change; forbidden while killed
Content-addressed snapshot row insert occurs inside T05 gated transaction
S2 run insert is part of T06 same-tx guard S2_WRITTEN_SAME_TX
S2 interval rows written in T06 transaction
ACTIVE pipeline version upsert before discovery insert
Successor PRIMARY row created in supersession transaction
Operator-only kill/disable path; never enables S4 when env is OFF (dbCanEnable=false)
